text:
maria_csm: Kickoff for HelioLabs dedicated bring-up. Customer requests reserved quota ~120k tokens/min, peak concurrency ~140. Target go-live: next Wed 10:00 PT. We need autoscale policy check, load-test windows, priming plan, rollback playbook. Dry-run = Mon 08:00 PT (smoke). Full run = Wed 08:00 PT (ramp to peak). @jia_devops can you run the tests? @omar_se confirm model variants. @amanda_sre own rollback.
jia_devops: I can run both. Proposed client ramp: steady 60qps for 20m, spike 140qps for 8m, tail 15qps for 30m. Will use k6 profile and export JSON.
maria_csm: sample k6 stage pasted below. Also recommend 20m warmup with top-20 prompts to prime KV cache.
```javascript
export let options = { stages: [ { duration: '10m', target: 60 }, { duration: '8m', target: 140 }, { duration: '30m', target: 15 } ] }
```
omar_se: Use redwood/gpt-small-v2 for full test. Fallback redwood/gpt-small-quant. Set MAX_IN_FLIGHT=160 for test. Pin model to v2 during the run.
amanda_sre: Rollback triggers: p95 > 500ms for 5m OR errors > 2%. Action: shift traffic to shared pool + notify oncall + rollback note to customer. I'll prepare runbook and escalation list.
capacity-bot: Reservation check OK. Reserving 38 GPUs for HelioLabs. Reservation ID RSRV-9924. Expires Wed 12:00 PT.
sarah_cs: I'll schedule 30m enablement call 30m after dry-run to review results.
jia_devops: Dry-run complete: peak limited to 75qps, p95=310ms, errors=1.4%. Found tokenizer edge-case causing 4% errors on long-tail; patched settings and replayed -> errors 0.3%. Uploading artifacts to s3://redwood-ops/heliolabs/dryrun-2430001111/ (results.json, prom-summary.csv). Will post final Wed config once validated.
maria_csm: thanks everyone. please ack when warmup artifacts and runbook link are posted.
